title: Airplane and Butterfly Push Toys Recalled by LS Import Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The wheels of the airplane and the balls at the tip of the butterfly's antenna can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 660.

title: Mima Recalls Moon 3-In-1 High Chairs Due to Fall and Impact Hazard
summary: The high chair seat can loosen and dislodge, allowing the seat and child to fall. The chair can also fall onto a child crawling underneath the seat, posing an impact hazard to the child. Units: About 1,470.

title: Sea Gull Lighting Recalls Chandeliers Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The chandelier's screw collar that holds the chandeliers to the ceiling mount can break causing the chandelier to fall and injure bystanders. Units: About 8,800 in the United States and 800 in Canada.

title: Children's Pajamas and Robes Recalled by Lazy One Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
summary: The footed pajamas and robes fail to meet the federal flammability standard for children's sleepwear, posing a burn hazard to children. Units: About 8,400.

title: Family Dollar Stores Recall Tough Treadz Auto Carrier Toy Sets Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The die-cast metal cars can have sharp edges that pose a laceration hazard. Units: About 254,000.

title: Lifesmart Recalls Lifepro Brand Portable Mini Space Heaters Due to Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: The screws used to attach the back plate to the heater are too short and allow the back plate to detach when removing the heater from the outlet, posing an electrical shock hazard to the user. Units: About 17,000.

title: Gibbs Sports Amphibians Recalls Quadski Amphibious Vehicles Due to Injury Risk
summary: The handlebar can fail while the vehicle is in operation, causing the operator to lose control of the steering and braking system of the vehicle, posing a risk of injury. Units: About 320.

title: Performance Packaging Recalls Children's Food Pouch Attachment Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The tube of the pouch topper that screws onto the food pouch can separate from the round base, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 6,000.

title: Pressmaster Recalls Cable Stripping Tool Due to Impact Hazard
summary: The tool's plastic end cap can fly off the product with force either during use or while in storage, posing an impact hazard. Units: About 325.

title: Hayneedle Recalls Fiber Optic Lighted Christmas Trees Made by East-West Basics Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The motor that turns the color disc can overheat, posing the risk of a fire. Units: About 220.

title: Tommy Bahama Recalls Hula Girl Cocktail Shaker and Glass Sets Due to Laceration Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The glass shaker can break or shatter unexpectedly, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 1,700.

title: SCOTT Recalls Vanish Evo Bicycle Helmets Due to Head Injury Hazard
summary: The bicycle helmets do not comply with the impact requirements of the CPSC safety standards for bicycle helmets. Units: About 1,450.

title: Jackco Transnational Recalls ZETA Battery Pack Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The battery packs can overheat, split apart and melt the battery pack's enclosure, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 5,000.

title: Kidde Recalls Disposable Plastic Fire Extinguishers Due to Failure to Discharge
summary: A faulty valve component can cause the disposable fire extinguishers not to fully discharge when the lever is repeatedly pressed and released during a fire emergency, posing a risk of injury. Units: About 4.6 million units in the U.S. and 175,000 in Canada.

title: KTM North America Recalls KTM Brand and Husqvarna Brand Enduro Motorcycles Due to a Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The front fork pistons can become stuck within the fork leg and cause the operator to lose control of the motorcycle and crash. Units: About 2,864 KTM brand and 457 Husqvarna brand.

title: SRAM Recalls Zipp 88 Bicycle Wheel Hubs Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
summary: The hub flange ring on the front hub can fail posing a crash and injury hazard. Units: About 12,000.

title: System Sensor Recalls Combination Carbon Monoxide and Smoke Detectors Due to Carbon Monoxide Hazard
summary: The detectors can fail to detect carbon monoxide gas in the home, posing a risk of carbon monoxide poisoning. Units: About 1,450.

title: Marin Mountain Bikes Recalls Children's Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard; Handlebars Can Loosen
summary: The handlebars can loosen or separate during use. This can cause the rider to lose control and/or crash, posing the risk of injury. Units: About 400 in the U.S. and 50 in Canada.

title: Cosco Recalls Convertible Hand Trucks Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The wheel hub can separate or break and eject pieces during inflation, posing a risk of injury to the consumer and bystanders. Units: About 273,000.

title: Fanimation Recalls Brewmaster Ceiling Fans Due to Risk of Injury
summary: The ceiling fan hub holding the blades can separate from the shaft when operating in reverse. If this happens, the fan blades and hub can fall and pose a risk of injury to bystanders. Units: 9300.

title: Kenmore Electric Ranges Recalled by Electrolux Due to Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: The heating element can fail to properly adhere to the cooktop, posing an electrical shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 3,000.

title: Safe Step Walk-In Tubs Recalled by Oliver Fiberglass Products and NuWhirl Systems Due to Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The tub's heated seat can get stuck in the "on" position. If a towel or other item is covering the seat of an empty tub, the seat can overheat, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 6,400.
